# TheFreeAITools.com — LLM Context File
# Updated: 2026-05-29
# Format: plain-text machine-readable site summary for AI assistants and crawlers.

## Canonical URL
https://www.thefreeaitools.com

## About
TheFreeAITools.com is a free, browser-based tools directory offering 200+ utilities
across AI, developer, design, security, image, text, file, and network categories.
No account, no subscription, no download required. All tools run client-side;
no user data is transmitted to or stored on our servers.

## Data & Privacy Policy
- Processing location: Client-side only (browser)
- Files uploaded: Never sent to our servers
- Text entered: Never logged or stored
- Accounts required: None
- Cost: Permanently free, no tiers
- Ads: Google AdSense (non-intrusive, no tracking beyond standard GA)
